decisions.what: JLC04161H-3313 4L standard (not impedance-controlled - FS does not need it); In1 GND, In2 +3V3; 3-sheet hierarchy usb/power/mcu, net names contractual (/USB_DP,/USB_DM root-labeled; /mcu/OSC_* couple constraints to sheet name - deliberate)
Settled: buck stands; LED 1k on PC13 (3mA limit); DP pull-up hardwired 1.5k; VBUS sense OMIT; shell->GND direct; VBUS caps exactly 10uF+100nF (USB inrush ceiling == buck C_IN)
decisions.why: All 7 research OPEN items closed with reasons in decisions.md

decisions.what: Inductor L1 DCR 60mOhm vs DS43698's <30mOhm recommendation: WAIVED - the <30 criterion targets 2A-class operation; this board peaks 57mA (0.2mW conduction loss). Isat 2.9A >> 1.35x requirement holds
decisions.why: Engineering waiver with math; schematic-reviewer may contest

decisions.what: ONE schematic-block agent owns all 3 sheets + root (vs one-per-sheet guidance)
decisions.why: 28-part board; hierarchy fully preserved in the OUTPUT; single agent is cheaper and avoids cross-agent refdes/net coordination risk at this size

decisions.what: Library edits approved: silk sanitize on C0603/C0805/R0603/LED (sub-minimum dots on pad 1) + U2 TSOT-26 gains a printable pin-1 dot; no lib_pull re-runs (easyeda2kicad dup bug + API 403)
decisions.why: Intra-footprint silk would hard-fail P5 self-check by design; U2 rotation = dead board
